rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Residential kerb with cars parked; houses 10-25 m away on both sides.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb on the west side at 12-20 m and more homes face it across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road wide enough for parked cars on both sides; room for a van in line.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with moderate through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars already park along both kerbs; no parking signs.

sun_shade: Large trees overhang the west kerb near the start; open further north.

best_section.where: West kerb of Hillsdon Road, mid-block between the two junctions
